steps.name: setup
steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.(); s.dismissChecklist?.(); s.setManualHour?.(13); s.setTimeMode?.('manual'); s.setLightsMode?.('on'); s.setQualityTier?.('realistic'); s.hideLoading?.(); s.setFeatureFlag?.('interactiveDegrade', false) })()

steps.name: pin
steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__store; s.getState().setDeviceClass('capable'); s.setState({ setDeviceClass: () => {} }) })()

steps.name: boot-splash-gone
steps.failMessage: #boot-loader still covering the screen (BOOT-SPLASH, v0.31.9.6) — every frame before this point is the loader.

steps.name: probe
steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__store.getState(); const cur = (s.items||[]).filter(i => /curtain|blind|drape/i.test(i.defId||'')); console.log('[probe] curtains', JSON.stringify(cur.map(i => ({ id: i.id, def: i.defId, pos: i.position.map(v=>+v.toFixed(3)), rot: +(i.rotation||0).toFixed(3), w: i.width, d: i.depth, h: i.height, props: i.props })))); const wins = (s.floorPlan.windows||[]).map(w => ({ id: w.id, wallId: w.wallId, offset: w.offset, width: w.width })); console.log('[probe] windows', JSON.stringify(wins.slice(0,12))) })()

steps.name: cam1
steps.eval: (() => { const { camera, controls } = window.__three; controls.enableDamping = false; camera.position.set(1.7,4.2,4.2); controls.target.set(1.7,1.5,0.4); controls.update(); window.__three.invalidate() })()

steps.name: cam2
steps.eval: (() => { const { camera, controls } = window.__three; camera.position.set(10.9,4.0,5.0); controls.target.set(10.9,1.5,1.5); controls.update(); window.__three.invalidate() })()

steps.name: cam3
steps.eval: (() => { const { camera, controls } = window.__three; camera.position.set(0.6,3.2,1.6); controls.target.set(2.2,1.6,0.6); controls.update(); window.__three.invalidate() })()

steps.name: p4
steps.eval: (() => { const l = window.__walkLook; l.setPosition(2.6, 2.4); l.setYaw(0.9); l.setPitch(0.05) })()

steps.name: draw-curtains
steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__store.getState(); for (const it of s.items) if (it.defId === 'curtains') s.updateItemProps(it.id, { drawAmount: 1 }) })()
